title: Third-party provenance retained in source but hidden from the rendered delivery surface
scope: single-Mother audition; Weather R49-R51 exact subjects
problem: A candidate can retain copyright and license notices in source while removing the only rendered teacher/reference disclosure, allowing the user-facing surface to imply sole project authorship or independent implementation.
distinctFrom: DECLARED_SOURCE_CLOSURE: source paths may exist and still be truthfully hidden from the rendered claim layer.
UNAUTHORIZED_CREATIVE_SUBSTITUTE: this case concerns provenance disclosure, not whether geometry or appearance was invented.
FREE_ASSET_LICENSE_NOT_REDISTRIBUTION: this case does not decide acquisition or redistribution rights; it verifies cross-layer claim consistency.

pass: No third-party material is present and exact source identity proves independent work.
Third-party material is present and the rendered surface states teacher/reference status.
A compact rendered surface provides a visible, working link to an attribution/source panel bound by digest.
gate.rule: Source comments and README provenance are necessary but cannot by themselves authorize a rendered claim that hides teacher/reference status. UI disclosure need not be verbose: a visible source/about link is sufficient when it resolves to complete bound attribution.

r49.renderedDisclosure: 拖动观察 · 原作参考

externalEvidence.use: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 section 3(a): retain creator/copyright/license/disclaimer/source URI where supplied, indicate modifications, and satisfy in a reasonable manner for the medium/context.
Creative Commons recommends Title/Author/Source/License and accessible links.
MIT requires copyright and permission notice in copies or substantial portions; this candidate does not claim that MIT itself mandates visible UI attribution.

boundaries: This is an operational truth/provenance gate, not a legal opinion.
It does not decide whether source-only attribution is legally sufficient in every medium.
It does not reject R50/R51 rendering quality or source modifications.
No production Mother, main, R2, global gate or public route is modified.
